donor_subject: Radar short-window duplicate suppression and admission rollback
adapted_mechanisms: reservation rollback after downstream admission failure
serialized reservation plus downstream write boundary
vera_specific_changes: retry key binds actor workstream and complete canonical CoordinationEventDraft
thread, source, target, status, payload, and reference data remain semantically material
distinct routes are not collapsed merely because payload bytes match
failed or denied coordination writes roll back the retry reservation
authority_rule: retry suppression changes write admission only; it grants no coordination permission, action authority, provider authority, memory admission, or protected-effect authority
